subject: Class and category of data items and literals
notes: Rule: '1) An elementary data item explicitly or implicitly described as usage index.' (cite.py OK). Both halves probed at --std 85 and 2023 (p5.cob/p6.cob): '01 G USAGE INDEX. 05 I1. 05 I2.' -- the IMPLICIT (inherited) leaves are index data items: SET I1 TO TX / SET TX TO I1 round-trip (TE(TX)=D), I1 < I2 relation true, MOVE 5 TO I1 rejected COBOL0809 (§14.9.25.3 SR1 class index) and COMPUTE N = I1 + 1 rejected COBOL0844 (class index not numeric). Explicit form covered by many goldens (e.g. 85/pb212_operand_class_screens) but no spec-derived test pins the IMPLICIT (group-inherited) half, so test-ref left empty (test-needed).
